h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Madhya Pradesh

items.pText: Madhya Pradesh sits in the centre of the country, about 690 km from our Vasai factory by road, and it is one of the easier states for us to supply. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, housing societies, municipal parks, resorts and government campuses across the state.

Buyers are spread widely. Indore has a fast-growing housing market and many private schools. Bhopal, the city of lakes, has government campuses and large public gardens. Gwalior and Jabalpur have cantonments, colleges and long-established schools, and Ujjain is a pilgrimage city with parks that fill up during festivals. Sagar, Guna and Shivpuri have schools and town parks that need durable equipment for daily use. Our installation team or a dealer in central India installs everything, self-standing or grouted, after you approve a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Black soil, heat and the monsoon

c: Much of western Madhya Pradesh, around Indore and Ujjain, has black cotton soil. It swells when wet and cracks when dry, which can tilt shallow foundations. On this soil we suggest deeper grouting or a firm prepared base, and a drainage slope so water does not sit under the equipment. Summers across the state are very hot and winters are cool, especially in the north around Gwalior. Plan shade over slides and decks that face the afternoon sun in April and May.

items.q: Does black cotton soil affect playground foundations?
items.a: Yes. It expands in the monsoon and shrinks in summer, which can move shallow bases. Deeper grouting or a firm prepared base with good drainage keeps the equipment level.

items.q: How far is Madhya Pradesh from your factory?
items.a: The state is about 690 km from our Vasai factory by road. We dispatch by truck and install with our team or a dealer in central India.

items.q: Can you plan a playground for a temple trust or pilgrimage town park?
items.a: Yes. Parks in pilgrimage towns get large crowds on festival days, so we suggest sturdy equipment with plenty of clear space. Share the site size and expected use.
